explanation: Append every new value and re-sort the stored collection. Its central entry is the odd-count median; the average of the two central entries is the even-count median. This displayed version uses sorting rather than two heaps.
timeComplexity: O(n log(n+1)) sorting upper bound per insertion; adaptive sorting of the nearly sorted collection may be faster. Median queries take O(1).
spaceComplexity: O(n) stored values and up to O(n) sorting workspace.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
